bio.text: Anthony Constantino, the CEO of Sticker Mule, won the Republican primary for New York's 21st Congressional District on June 23, 2026.
The Daily Gazette reported that he had been endorsed by President Donald Trump in April 2026, and that he will also appear on the independent Taxpayer Rights line in November.
The seat is open after Rep. Elise Stefanik announced in December that she would not seek another term; his Democratic opponent is Blake Gendebien.

sources.title: Constantino earns win over Smullen in NY-21, will face Gendebien
